name: Bianca Buchelli
bio: Bianca Buchelli is a known actress for the film Sobre el Acantilado.

credits.title: On Top of the Cliff
credits.overview: In 1950s Lima, a Catholic girls' boarding school clings to a cliff above the Pacific Ocean. Ana, 16, pursues holiness obsessively, secretly mortifying her body. When Rebecca, a rebellious foreigner, arrives at the school, Ana’s leadership starts to crack. As fascination turns into jealousy and desire clashes with faith
